[SWS_CM_11271] SecOC secure channel behavior
⌈
Whenever a SecOC
secure channel interaction is detected (based on the configuration options of
[SWS_CM_90108], [SWS_CM_90115], [SWS_CM_90109], [SWS_CM_90116], and
[SWS_CM_90110]) the SecOC functionality shall be applied according to:
• sending according to [SWS_CM_11272], [SWS_CM_11274]
• reception according to [SWS_CM_11273], [SWS_CM_11275]
⌋
